numbering.explanation: Two-digit shortcuts are local to a menu. Programming groups 00–24 and Tests & Diagnostics entries 00–12 are printed explicitly. Parameter and option numbers belong to their own field; they are not global menu addresses.
caveats: The manual chapter heading “4. Tests and Diagnostics” is not shortcut 04.
Top-level numbering and order require hardware confirmation because p30 screenshots and text conflict.
Order within field/value lists follows the document; an indexed parameter is not necessarily a separate LCD submenu.

navigation.action: Return one level in the menu. In editing contexts left may instead change a value; follow the displayed context.
Read context-sensitive help for the highlighted programming item.
Copy / paste the highlighted programming item.

gaps.title: Actual panel and firmware baseline
gaps.question: Which Orisec control-panel models and software versions should FINDR target? Please provide the About lines for both panel and keypad.
gaps.reason: INS008 is a 2018 baseline; the current public range includes other models. The keypad appearance does not determine panel firmware.

gaps.question: On that firmware, what are the complete engineer-menu labels and numbers, particularly System Event Logs and Log off & exit?

gaps.neededEvidence: A slow scroll or successive photos of the authorised engineer menu with highlighted labels and numbers visible.

gaps.title: Two Beam pair timers
